note: Question-only execution input. One user turn per item; one new conversation per item. No expectations.

fresh_answerable.utterance: I've just started as a care worker. How long is my probation, and when are my formal review meetings?
I've been invited to a disciplinary hearing. Can I bring my husband with me?
How often should the first aid box be checked, and where do I record it when I've treated someone's minor cut?
A resident's daughter phoned asking to see everything we hold about her mum. What should I do, and how long do we have to respond?
My colleague has forgotten her password. Can I let her log in with mine for the rest of the shift?
If I opt out of the workplace pension, will I be put back into it later?
How long do we keep CCTV footage, and who is allowed to watch it?
I'm taking the pool car out for a community visit this morning. What checks do I need to do before I drive off?
I'm about to reach 10 years with Alderbridge. What do I get for that?
I've just noticed a bruise on a resident's arm and nobody knows how it happened. What do I need to do?
Am I allowed to check my personal email on a work computer?
The care records system has gone down. Who do I contact, and when does it get escalated?
On 10 March 2025, how could a care home place an emergency medication order when a resident's supply ran low unexpectedly?
What was the staff turnover target in June 2026?
In October 2024, did a staff member's signed-off competency need re-validating every year?
When our clinical waste was collected in May 2025, what record of the collection did we have to keep?
Was checking right-to-work documents before a new starter's first day mandatory in 2025, and is it now?
Before September 2026, did every new starter have to be given a buddy, and what's the rule now?
How often was the dignity in care audit carried out in October 2026, and how often is it now?
Did the April 2026 update to the catering and menu policy change the menu cycle?
I'm leaving next month. Do I have to do an exit interview, who would run it, and when would it happen?
I'm writing a risk assessment for a resident day trip. Who needs to sign it, who do I share it with, and how often must it be reviewed?
The power has gone off during a night shift. When do I need to call the on-call manager, and should I open the medication fridge to check the medicines?
A resident wants to make a decision her family thinks is unwise. Does that mean she lacks capacity, and if she's assessed as lacking capacity for it, how must the decision be made and recorded?

controls.utterance: How many days of annual leave does a full-time employee get, including bank holidays?
Can I ask what data Alderbridge holds about me, and who do I send that request to?
When was the last fire drill at my home, and how long did the evacuation take?
What does Alderbridge's approved social media policy say about staff connecting with residents' families online?

The meds fridge has packed up—who must I call now, and what extra call was added in April 2026?

I'm updating our response card for a lost encrypted work device. What is the control called now, and who classifies the incident, how quickly must the DPO assess it, and which out-of-hours route was added?

I'm updating our safeguarding card for a resident-money discrepancy. Who receives the first escalation now, what part does Finance keep, and which current role name and outside-agency sharing route should the card use?
At Oakfield outreach on 1 July 2026, when did a key safe need reviewing and what had to happen when it was no longer needed?
